errors.text_span: въз основа на легендата се предполага, че стойностите са в хиляди левове
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the units (thousands of levs) are inferred from the legend. The units are explicitly stated in the figure caption: "(в хил.лв.)".

errors.text_span: Сивата линия, означена като „Стойност на активите“, започва при стойност около 65 000
errors.evidence: The gray line ("Стойност на активите") starts visibly below the orange line, which starts at approximately 65,000. The gray line's starting point is closer to 64,000. Stating it starts at 65,000 incorrectly implies it starts at the same value as the orange line.

errors.text_span: Синята линия, означена като „Печалба“, започва при стойност около 11 000 и завършва при около 10 000
errors.evidence: The values for the blue line ("Печалба") are inaccurate. It starts slightly above 10,000 (closer to 10,500, not 11,000) and ends visibly below 10,000 (closer to 9,000, not 10,000). These inaccuracies misrepresent the magnitude of the profit decline.
